=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/heal_reproduce.sh:227-243 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The last run removed the `if not names and path_entries == 1: matched = True` rule, so the inherited branch of `map_entry` now returns `("unverified", "names_incomplete")` for any inherited `::name` entry with empty parsed names. `failing_names()` (workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:703-729) parses only `FAILED <node>` lines, never pytest `ERROR <node>` lines, and inherited entries carry no tail (run_gate, line 946). As a result, a test that fails only in fixture setup or teardown always comes back as `names: []`.
  WHY: In heal-editor run 2 (`--sha F --baseline F`, scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh:838-846), the `at_failing`/`cmd_final` path returns `unverified` and exits 43. implement.yml then refuses correct setup-error heals with `repro_not_fixed` and `ai:needs-human`, even when run 1 showed the test passes and the intake mapped the same failure to `reproduced/regression` (scripts/heal_reproduce.sh:192-200). Suggested fix: expose `"rc": r.get("rc")` on inherited entries and accept a sole `::name` entry only when rc is not 4/5, or parse ERROR node names. All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:1352-1389 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The PR adds `--tests-file` support to the hook template but does not sync the live hook copy, which has no `--tests-file` argument. The parity check (tests/test_claude_template_live_parity.py:48-53) rejects the mismatch.
  WHY: The `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` check fails on the PR head because the live `hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py` differs from its template, and the CI log confirms the assertion fails at `drift == []`. The source rated it BLOCKER, and the same gap is reported as a task gap by 4 other reviewers.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:659-691 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `_verify_one`, the `marker_rc -eq 2` (marker unknown) branch keeps the heal reopened and escalates, but line 691 `[ "${marker_rc}" -eq 2 ] || log "outcome=recurred ..."` skips the `outcome=` line. Only the `warn ... reclosed=false` line is logged.
  WHY: Log-based outcome accounting and any consumer that keys on `outcome=recurred` miss this event. If the marker did not land, the next recurrence's `prior_recurred` count is one short and that recurrence will not escalate. The impact is limited to observability. Both reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:659-665 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: When the recurred-marker comment POST fails or returns a malformed response, the script continues with a warning (correct fail-open), but the reclosed heal issue may lose the recurrence marker.
  WHY: If the marker is lost, the next verification tick re-verifies the issue and may re-post escalation alerts that are not needed. The source rated it NIT.
- agents.d/heal-implement-repro-check.md:2 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The run-2 sentence still says every failing test comes back `pre_existing`. After the last-run change, a setup or teardown error with no parsed names comes back `unverified/names_incomplete`. Only the sibling agents.d/heal-reproduce.md was updated.
  WHY: The fragment misstates the implement-phase contract and contradicts agents.d/heal-reproduce.md in the same PR, which would send a maintainer looking for the wrong reason token when a heal is refused with `unverified`. The source rated it NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raise the same point as hardening suggestions.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The PR edits `workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py` (the `--tests-file` gate change, #8461 / plan P2). The template/live-copy contract requires the live copy `.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py` to match its template byte for byte and in mode (enforced by `tests/test_claude_template_live_parity.py::test_live_copies_match_their_templates`).
  expected_change_site: .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py (live copy, synced byte for byte from the template, mode included)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The PR changed-file list contains only the template copy, and no hunk touches `.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py`. The live copy is still the pre-feature 1425-line file, with no `--tests-file` in `run_parser` (lines 1376-1382) and no `tests_file` handling in `_selection_from_args` (lines 1352-1359) or `plan_units` (lines 563-624). The failing check-run `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` (run 41354829768, head 5aa138b3) reports "Live .claude/ copies differ from workflow-templates/.claude/ for: hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py" (tests/test_claude_template_live_parity.py:49). The PR-only tolerance (`tests/claude_template_drift.py`, `CLAUDE_PARITY_PR_BASE_SHA`) does not cover the push CI run on `orchestrator/project-8434`. Hooks are committed security paths (`SECURITY_LIVE_PREFIXES = ("hooks/",)`, scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py:73), and the path is sandbox-excluded, so the fix needs the trusted post-merge `sync-claude-live-copies` PR or a trusted operator sync. A `.github/ai/claude_template_divergence.json` entry is not acceptable for a hook. Severity varied: BLOCKER from sonnet and gemini, MAJOR from minimax and glm.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/heal_reproduce.sh:map_entry inherited branch | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: After the `if not names and path_entries == 1: matched = True` rule was removed, a named test that fails only in fixture setup or teardown can no longer reach `pre_existing` in run 2. Inherited entries are built with `"names": failing_names(r.get("tail", ""))` and no tail and no rc (workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:946). `failing_names` (lines 703-729) never parses `ERROR <node>`, so the entry has the same shape as a node missing on both trees (rc 4/5).
  WHY: The intake maps the same test to `reproduced/regression`, so the planner can emit `REPRODUCIBLE` with `[repro-required]`. Run 2 then returns `unverified/names_incomplete`, the script exits 43, and implement.yml refuses with `repro_not_fixed` and adds `ai:needs-human`. Suggested fix: add `"rc": r.get("rc")` at prepush_affected_tests.py:946, or document the fail-closed case in the agents fragment.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:659-691 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: In `_verify_one`, when `marker_rc -eq 2` and `prior_recurred` is 0, the heal stays reopened but no `outcome=` line is written; only `warn ... reclosed=false` appears.
  WHY: Log outcome accounting has no terminal outcome for this heal. If the marker did not land, the escalation count after an unconfirmed first recurrence is one too low. The impact is limited to observability.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The PR changes workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py (`--tests-file`, plan_units, classify_baseline, run_gate). tests/test_claude_template_live_parity.py::test_live_copies_match_their_templates requires the live .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py to match its template.
  Expected change site: .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py (byte-for-byte sync from the template, mode included)
  Evidence of absence: No hunk touches the live copy. tests-hooks-and-orchestrator (run 41354829768, head 5aa138b3) fails with "Live .claude/ copies differ from workflow-templates/.claude/ for: hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py". The path is sandbox-excluded, so the fix needs a trusted operator sync or the post-merge sync PR. The copilot-pull-request-reviewer failure (custom_instructions_too_large, HTTP 422) is on the service side and does not map to this diff.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- HARDENING (2 related items, HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1):
  - agents.d/heal-implement-repro-check.md, run-2 sentence: document that a test failing only in setup or teardown comes back `unverified/names_incomplete` and is always refused with `repro_not_fixed` (1 line).
  - scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh `_verify_one`, line 691: always log `outcome=recurred` with a ` comment=unconfirmed` suffix when `marker_rc` is 2, and add the token to the WORKFLOW_HEAL_VERIFY entry in agents.d/heal-verify.md (2 lines).
